title: Queen’s acronyms at work
intro: Try 9 staff scenarios, then browse 74 abbreviations by topic. Every page links to its Queen’s source.

pages.label: Staff induction · Recall
pages.title: Everyday systems
pages.text: A colleague asks where to sign in for links to University services. Which three letters name the portal?

media.webLabel: Queen’s Online service catalogue

practice.title: Name the abbreviation
practice.prompt: Say it or write it in your reading notes, then check.
practice.answer: QOL · Queen’s Online. The portal brings staff and student services together.
